name: shadowgpt-humanizer
description: Rewrite text so it reads naturally, and check how human a text reads, with your ShadowGPT account.

interface.longDescription:
ShadowGPT is a writing tool that rewrites text so it reads like natural human writing, while keeping its meaning. It's built for emails, posts, articles, product copy and support replies that come out stiff, repetitive or robotic.

What you can do in ChatGPT:
• Humanize text: paste or reference any text and get a natural-sounding rewrite, with a Unique score and sentence highlights (green reads natural, yellow could still be improved).
• Check text: see how natural a text reads before you rewrite it, with the stiffest, most machine-sounding sentences highlighted.
• Humanize more: improve only the sentences that still sound stiff, keeping the rest.
• Rehumanize: get a fresh rewrite of the whole result.
• Deep analysis: open the result in your ShadowGPT workspace for sentence-by-sentence alternatives.

Sign in with your ShadowGPT account (Google or email) to connect.
capabilities: Rewrite text so it reads naturally
Score how human a text reads
Open results in the ShadowGPT workspace
defaultPrompt: Humanize this text so it sounds natural:
Check how human this text reads:
Rewrite my last answer with ShadowGPT so it sounds less robotic

positive.prompt: Use ShadowGPT to humanize this: Artificial intelligence is transforming the way businesses operate across many industries. By automating repetitive tasks, AI allows employees to focus on more strategic and creative work. Furthermore, machine learning models can analyze vast amounts of data to uncover insights that would otherwise remain hidden.
positive.expected_behavior: humanize_text is called with the pasted text. The widget shows the rewritten text with a Unique score chip and verdict, sentence highlights, words and requests left, Copy, Rehumanize and Deep analysis. The assistant does not rewrite or summarize the returned text.

positive.description: Check how human a text reads
positive.prompt: Check this text for AI with ShadowGPT: In today's fast-paced world, it is important to note that sustainable transportation plays a pivotal role in shaping vibrant communities. Furthermore, the implementation of comprehensive infrastructure solutions can significantly enhance overall quality of life for all stakeholders involved. Ultimately, cities that embrace these strategies will foster resilience and long-term prosperity.
positive.expected_behavior: check_ai_score is called (not humanize_text). The widget shows the Unique score, a verdict such as 'Flagged as AI', highlighted sentences, and a 'Humanize this' button. The text is not rewritten.

positive.description: Humanize an answer ChatGPT just wrote
positive.prompt: Write a short LinkedIn post announcing our new office in Lisbon. Then humanize it with ShadowGPT.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT drafts the post, then calls humanize_text with that draft. The widget shows the rewritten post with its Unique score and requests left.
get_account returns the connected account's email and remaining requests; the assistant states them plainly.

positive.description: Check, then humanize from the widget
positive.prompt: Is this AI-written? Use ShadowGPT. Moreover, leveraging data-driven insights enables decision-makers to navigate complex challenges with confidence, fostering a more inclusive and resilient landscape for all stakeholders across the organization. Ultimately, embracing innovative paradigms empowers teams to unlock new opportunities and drive sustainable growth in an ever-evolving marketplace.
positive.expected_behavior: check_ai_score returns the score and highlights. Pressing 'Humanize this' in the widget calls humanize_text with the same text and shows the rewritten result in place.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: No ShadowGPT tool is called; ChatGPT answers normally.

negative.prompt: Translate 'Good morning, how are you?' into Spanish.
negative.expected_behavior: No ShadowGPT tool is called; the plugin only rewrites or scores text the user provides and does not translate.

negative.prompt: Humanize this with ShadowGPT: Hello there.
negative.expected_behavior: humanize_text returns a neutral 'too short' result without using a request; no rewrite is shown and nothing is charged.

publication.release_notes: First release: humanize text, check how human a text reads, Humanize more, Rehumanize and Deep analysis in your ShadowGPT workspace.
